adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365video/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts`, the refresh flow calls `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "msteams", credential.userId)`. The new sync mechanism posts `{ calcomUserId, appSlug }` to `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, and the corresponding credential push webhook (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`) validates `appSlug` by looking up `prisma.app` with `where: { slug: reqBody.appSlug }` and then `appStoreMetadata[app.slug]`. If the Office365 Video app’s slug is `office365video` (as suggested by the package/integration path), sending `msteams` would cause the sync/correlation to fail (app lookup/metadata lookup mismatch), breaking credential sync for this integration when enabled.
